name: Ground bounce momentum pump: chained ground bounces grow the hyper's momentum
techNote: A metal floor (top y 0). A hyper (jump, dash down-right, jump on dash frame 4: 1650 momentum right), then five ground bounces in a row, each a straight-down dash 9 input ticks after the last jump (the dash cooldown) with jump on dash frame 2, the stick at rest. Each landing's endDash gives back 95 % of preDashMomentum.x and sets DashBounceFrames 4 (no ground friction), and the bounce jump adds momentum.x * 0.5: the momentum right after the bounces is 1736.7, 1927.0, 2143.5, 2390.1, 2670.8 (ticks 22, 40, 58, 76, 94; +11 % a cycle, each at the same height, 586.6 momentum up), where one bounce and a coast decays to nothing. The fifth bounce's arc is in the finish box (x 2465 to 2565, y 250 to 350); the `once` ghost (the first bounce, then no more dashes) is at x 1692 on tick 104 with 124 momentum left. Bounce ticks and momentum: tick 22 1736.7, tick 40 1927.0, tick 58 2143.5, tick 76 2390.1, tick 94 2670.8.
